project.name: Company URL Finder - Advanced Multi-Tier URL Extraction
project.overview: Production-grade automated web scraping system that performs Google searches to discover company websites with comprehensive URL extraction using Selenium WebDriver

1_three_tier_url_extraction.objective: Extract base URL, same-domain sub-URLs, and diverse additional URLs for comprehensive company web presence mapping

sub_urls.description: URLs from the same domain as base_url (subpages, sections)

additional_urls.description: First 10 Google search results (unfiltered, diverse sources)
additional_urls.filtering: None - includes all domains (Wikipedia, LinkedIn, news sites, etc.)
additional_urls.deduplication: Excludes URLs already in base_url or sub_urls

2_performance_optimization.objective: Maintain fast search times while enabling JavaScript for reliability

optimizations_applied.impact: Don't wait for full page render

domain_detection.description: Intelligent same-domain detection for sub_urls extraction
handles: Different TLDs as separate domains (.com vs .de)
Similar company names as separate domains (braehler.com ≠ braehler-systems.com)

deduplication.logic: additional_urls excludes all URLs in base_url and sub_urls

edge_cases_handled: Companies with fewer than 10 total URLs
Person names instead of company names
Multiple pages from same external domain in additional_urls

metrics_tracked: Average, fastest, and slowest search times

resume_capability.description: Automatically resumes from last processed company
resume_capability.implementation: Loads existing results and skips processed companies

error_handling.description: Graceful error handling with detailed logging

resource_management.description: Proper WebDriver cleanup in finally block

technical_specifications.output_format: JSON array of company objects with URLs
